name: mamba3-data-governance-v1

field_contract.text: raw sample text, not templated unless it is an instruction dataset
field_contract.license: license or terms tag; unknown is not allowed for training
field_contract.language: ISO language code; English-first path expects en
field_contract.quality_score: float 0..1 or integer bucket normalized upstream
field_contract.dedup_hash: stable exact or fuzzy dedup hash
field_contract.benchmark_contamination_flag: boolean; true samples are blocked from train
field_contract.teacher_model: none for human/raw data, otherwise exact generator or judge model id
field_contract.generation_date: ISO-8601 date or null for raw historical data

notes: The architecture remains pure Mamba-3; teacher_model is data provenance, not a model architecture dependency.
Any synthetic, preference, or Magpie-style sample must keep teacher_model and generation_date.
